_comment: EVAL FIXTURE — an external definition-source stand-in (models a dictionary/KB/LLM gloss feeding definition_provider). This is NOT the wrapper's curated TERM_GLOSSES and is NOT loaded by the production path. Ambiguous terms carry sense keys matched against an example's 'context' field; otherwise 'default' is used. Terms absent here exercise the raw-term fallback.
